structure.unit: Election Districts, Precincts, and Polling Places

law.catch_line: Effect of reapportionment on appointments and terms of local officers, school board and planning commission members
law.text: County, city, or town officers, including members of the school board or planning commission, in office on the effective date of a reapportionment or redistricting ordinance, shall complete their terms of office, regardless of loss of residency in a particular district due to reapportionment or redistricting.
